note: Three gate majors held: the oath *si* as *Não entrarei … não subirei … não darei … nem … nem* (the *si* of oath row, 94:10, 88:36; MS1932, CNBB). The literal *Se eu entrar…* is heard as an unfinished condition.
*Levantai-vos, Senhor, para o vosso repouso*, where Brazil sings the Hebrew-based Assumption-vigil refrain *Subi, Senhor, para o lugar de vosso pouso*.
*Bendizendo, bendirei* keeps the figure and the open *benedícere* row (D11); the blind reader found it odd, and every Brazilian text says *abençoar*. *Abençoando, abençoarei* if the row moves.

*o chifre de Davi*, genitive (the Latinist), replaced the Greek's dative *um chifre para Davi*, which the stylist and the blind reader heard as cuckoldry. The dative's parallel with *para o meu Cristo* is the cost.
